facts.claim: Congestion pricing (Central Business District Tolling) charges passenger vehicles entering Manhattan below 60th St
NYC speed limit defaults to 25 mph citywide (Vision Zero); Sammy's Law allows 20 mph zones
Local Law 97 caps building carbon emissions with fines from 2024 compliance periods
NYC land is predominantly private freehold under city zoning (NYC Zoning Resolution); streets/parks are city-owned
NYC city budget headline is of the order of USD 110-115 billion

budget.note: Order-of-magnitude; PolicyAgent grounding refreshes at runtime.
